language.title: Let's start with your language
language.body: Your journey is easier when details are clear.

splash.tagline: Take care of your car. And go.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your email and password.
login.heading: Welcome back
login.passwordUpdated: Password updated. You can sign in now.
login.linkExpired: This link doesn't work. Open it on the same phone you asked from, or request a new one.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Create an account to save your data and track your car maintenance.
register.heading: Start your journey
register.consent: By creating an account you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.heading: Forgot your password?

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.heading: New password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: We sent a link to your email. Open it on this phone.
verifyEmail.resendBody: Check your spam folder, or try again in a minute.

profileSetup.title: Your profile
profileSetup.subtitle: This name will appear in your profile and shared records.
profileSetup.heading: Let's get to know you

errors.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters

voice.title:
Say what you did.
We'll write it down.
voice.body: Just say "changed the oil" and it lands in your car's logbook.

reminders.title:
Your next service
remembers itself.
reminders.body: We remind you before it's due, by kilometres or by months.

history.title:
A history
buyers can trust.
history.body: When you sell, share the whole record with one link.

saveCar.title: Save your {{name}}
saveCar.body: Create an account to keep your car's history safe, get reminders on time and log by voice.

odometer.title: This is where we start calculating
odometer.label: Current odometer reading
odometer.body: This reading will help us calculate your upcoming maintenance schedule.

firstLog.title: What was your last maintenance?
firstLog.body: One record is enough to start scheduling.

home.title: Ready for the next step?
home.allGood: All your parts are on schedule. Nothing needs your attention today.

empty.title: A simple start. A big difference.
empty.heading: Start with one car
empty.body: Add your car, then log your first service. Everything will be ready for your next trip.

guest.welcomeBody: Create an account to save your data and unlock features.

gate.heading: All the details, in your account
gate.body: Create an account to keep your maintenance history and track parts and expenses.

odometer.label: New reading
odometer.noteBody: We'll ask for a reason, like a replaced odometer or a corrected reading, before saving.

scan.rowSub: Point it at the number under the speedometer.
scan.hint: Point the camera at the kilometer digits
scan.torch: Turn the flashlight on or off
scan.slow: We couldn't read it yet. Try getting a bit closer, or type the number yourself.
scan.denied: Camera access is turned off. Allow it in your phone's settings, or type the number yourself.
scan.unavailable: The camera isn't available on this device. Use the slider or type the number.
scan.read: Read from the camera. Add the reason, then save.
scan.lowerNote: Lower than the saved reading ({{current}}). We'll ask for a reason before saving.
scan.higherNote: Much higher than the saved reading ({{current}}). Check it before you confirm.
scan.asking: Taking a closer look. Hold still for a moment…

vehicles.title: My cars
vehicles.heading: All your cars, together
vehicles.emptyParts: Add a record to see part schedules

pick.type: Not on our list yet. Type the name and tap it below.

history.title: Every set has its journey
history.subtitle: Replacing a part doesn't erase the previous part's history.

index.title: What did you do?
index.subtitle: Choose whichever suits you best.
index.noteBody: You'll review the details before any record is saved.

voice.hint: Take your time. Tap done when you finish.
voice.noSpeech: We didn't catch that. Try again.
voice.typeHint: Speech recognition is unavailable, type what you would say
voice.aiNotice: Your recording is sent to an AI service to write your records. We don't keep it.
voice.noPreview: We're recording. Your records appear when you tap done.
voice.understandingBody: We're writing your records. This takes a few seconds.

capture.micDenied: We couldn't use the microphone. Enter the record manually.

batch.title: Here's what we understood
batch.tapHint: Tap any record to edit it.
batch.missingAmount: Add the amount so we can save
batch.missingCategory: Choose what this expense was for so we can save
batch.lowerReading: Lower than the current reading ({{value}}). Fix it or remove this record.
batch.emptyBody: You removed every record. Record again or enter it yourself.
batch.nothingUnderstood: We didn't pick up any record from what you said. Try again with a clearer sentence, or enter it manually.
batch.aiFailed: We couldn't understand the recording right now. Enter the record manually.
batch.dailyLimit: You've reached today's voice recording limit. Enter the record yourself, and voice will be back tomorrow.
batch.longHint: You're near the time limit. We'll finish the recording automatically.
batch.partialFail: We saved {{saved}} of {{total}}. The rest couldn't be saved and are still in the list.
batch.successReview: One reading looked unusual, so it's marked for review.

review.title: One last step, then save
review.noteBody: You didn't mention a date. We used today's date. You can edit it.

history.title: Every step, saved
history.emptyBody: Every oil change, inspection or new part deserves to stay saved.

log.voiceBody: Created from what you said, reviewed by you.
log.correctedBody: Corrections appear next to the original.
log.originalBody: You can add a correction with a reason. The correction appears next to the original record.

corrections.title:
Details improve.
The original stays.
corrections.footnote: The number of corrections shows when sharing car history, for transparency.

review.title: Shall we review this reading?
review.body: The distance went up by {{diff}} km in {{days}} days. We saved the record with a note for you to review.
review.noteBody: Confirming doesn't remove the note from the record.
review.bodyLower: This reading is {{diff}} km lower than the previous one. We saved the record with a note for you to review.

empty.title: First date starts with a record
empty.body: Log a service and set its interval. We'll line up your next date.

how.both: Based on your latest reading of {{odo}} {{unit}} and {{schedule}} for this part: every {{km}} {{unit}} or {{m}} months, whichever comes first.
how.km: Based on your latest reading of {{odo}} {{unit}} and the interval: every {{km}} {{unit}}.
how.months: Based on the last service date and the interval: every {{m}} months.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.caption: EGP · on {{count}} cars
expenses.emptyTitle: Your expenses are clearer from the start
expenses.emptyBody: Add an expense, or log a service with its cost. You'll see the details here.
expenses.linkHint: Added as an extra cost for this record.
expenses.fullTankHint: Turn off if you didn’t fill it to the top

notify.overdueBody: It's past its date. Log the service once it's done.
notify.weeklyBody: See what's coming up for your cars.

account.subtitle: Your account is ready for the next step
account.shareSub: Move the history to the new owner
account.darkSub: Easier on the eyes at night
account.signOutBody: You'll need to sign in again.
account.switchBody: Bestim will restart to apply the language.

notifPrefs.title: Notifications
notifPrefs.heading: Alerts your way
notifPrefs.dueSoonSub: When the due date is near
notifPrefs.overdueSub: When the due date has passed
notifPrefs.footnote: We alert you when the state changes, with no daily repeat for the same reminder.
notifPrefs.bannerOff: Notifications are off for Bestim on this device.
notifPrefs.saveError: We couldn't save your choices. Try again.

export.title: Share what you choose
export.footnote: The recipient sees how many items were left out, not their content.
export.error: We couldn't prepare the file. Try again.

file.title: Bestim · Car log
file.excluded: The owner excluded {{n}} items (their content isn't shown).

share.title: Its history goes with it
share.body: Share the logs, reminders and parts with the new owner.
share.note: Sharing the car's history only. This doesn't transfer legal ownership of the car.
share.empty: Add at least one record to share.
share.error: We couldn't prepare the share. Try again.
share.message: I shared the maintenance history of {{vehicle}} on Bestim: {{link}}

receive.title: A car history is waiting
receive.body: Review the details before adding this history to your account.
receive.invalidBody: It may have expired or been used already. Ask the sender to share again.
receive.own: This is your own share. Open the link on the other person's phone.
receive.retryBody: We couldn't load your data right now.

error.title: Shall we try again?
error.body: We couldn't load your data right now. Your saved records are still there.
error.saved: View what's saved on this device

offline.bannerBody: You can write a new record. We'll sync it when you're back online.
offline.title: We continue where you are
offline.vehicleSub: Last data saved on this device
offline.cardNote: {{unit}} · check your connection to update schedules
offline.voiceSheet: Voice recording needs a connection for guests.

success.logBody: We saved the record and updated your next maintenance date.
success.reviewBody: We saved the record. The reading looks unusual, so it's marked for review.
success.offlineBody: Saved on this device. We'll sync it when you're back online.
success.noPhoto: The receipt photo needs a connection, so it wasn't attached.
success.vehicleBody: Next step? Log your last service and we'll arrange its reminders.

notify.title: Let us remind you on time
notify.body: We'll notify you when maintenance is near or overdue. You can change your preferences anytime.

deleteVehicle.title: Delete car from your account?
deleteVehicle.body: Its records and schedules will be deleted. You cannot recover them.
deleteVehicle.error: We couldn't delete the car. Try again.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account permanently?
deleteAccount.body: Your account and all your cars, records, reminders and expenses will be deleted. You won't be able to get them back.
deleteAccount.error: We couldn't delete your account. Try again.

deleteGuest.title: Delete your guest data permanently?
deleteGuest.body: Your car and its records, reminders and expenses will be deleted. You won't be able to get them back.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No internet connection. Check it and try again.
errors.emailTaken: This email already has an account. Sign in instead.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first. Check your inbox.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password different from your old one.
errors.google: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again or use your email.

errorScreen.title: Something went wrong
errorScreen.body: Don't worry, your data is safe. Please try again.

fuel.title: Fuel consumption
fuel.hint: Add litres and the reading to two full-tank fill-ups to see consumption

inbox.emptyBody: Reminders about your car will show up here.

voiceQueue.savedBody: Your recording is saved on this phone. We will write it up when you are back online, then you review it.
voiceQueue.readyBody: Open it to check the records and save them.
voiceQueue.failedTitle: We couldn’t write up this recording

failed.ai: Something went wrong while reading it. Try again, or delete it and add the record by hand.
failed.limit: You reached today’s voice limit. Try again tomorrow.

voiceQueue.waitingBody: It will be sent as soon as the phone is online.
